name: event_id
description: UUID assigned when the event is written to Postgres's warehouse_outbox. The *_dedup views keep one row per event_id.

name: event_ts
description: When the event happened in the control plane (UTC). Day partitions use this column.

name: fingerprint
description: Finding fingerprint, so value survives a finding being reopened.

name: stage
description: found, proposed, merged, verified_closed, declined or rolled_back.

name: issue_type
description: Finding type used to look up the value model constant.

name: minutes_absorbed
description: Engineer minutes this stage saved, from docs/value-model.md (Phase 7).

name: value_model_version
description: Version of docs/value-model.md the constant came from.

name: proposal_id
description: Fix proposal, for proposed and later stages.

name: user_id
description: Postern account ID (UUID). Never an email or a name.

name: connection_id
description: ID of the connection (one connected Supabase project) the event concerns.
